slides.headline: AI can find a flaw faster than a team can fix it.
slides.alt_text: AI can find a flaw faster than a team can fix it. Anthropic launched OSS Scanner on October 8, 2026.

slides.headline: Free security scans for open-source projects.
slides.alt_text: Free security scans for open-source projects. Opt-in scans use Anthropic models. Reports include an explanation and a suggested fix where available.

slides.headline: The reports arrive without human review.
slides.alt_text: The reports arrive without human review. Anthropic acknowledges possible inaccuracies. Maintainers still need to verify findings.

slides.headline: More findings can create more review work.
slides.alt_text: More findings can create more review work. My takeaway: measure verified repairs and review effort, alongside vulnerability discovery.

slides.headline: Would AI security reports help your team?
slides.alt_text: Would AI security reports help your team? Or add to the backlog? Start with a workflow for verifying each finding.
